class.name: SteamDlcProgress
class.brief_description: Detached download progress for one optional DLC.
class.description: Get a fresh record from [method SteamApps.download_progress] when updating a progress display.

method.name: get_downloaded_bytes
method.description: Returns Steam's downloaded byte count, or zero when inactive.

method.name: get_total_bytes
method.description: Returns Steam's total download size in bytes, or zero when inactive or unknown.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether Steam reported an active optional DLC download.

members.member: Whether Steam was downloading the DLC when queried. Both byte counts are zero for an inactive transfer.
Number of bytes downloaded for the active transfer. Zero while inactive.
Total download size in bytes. Zero indicates an inactive transfer or an unknown total.
